cmd: tc filter add dev v0p1 ingress protocol ip prio 98 u32 link 43: hashkey mask 0x0000ff00 at 12 match ip src 192.168.0.0/16
desc: positive: Add u32 filter that links to a custom hash table

match.pattern: (?sm)filter protocol ip pref 98 u32 chain (0[ ]+$|0 fh 801: ht divisor 1|0 fh 801::800 order 2048 key ht 801 bkt 0 link 43:.*match c0a80000/ffff0000 at 12.*hash mask 0000ff00 at 12)

pre: ip link add v0p1 type veth peer name v0p0 && ip link set v0p1 up && ip link set v0p0 up
tc qdisc add dev v0p1 ingress
tc filter add dev v0p1 ingress prio 99 handle 43: u32 divisor 256

readback.cmd: tc filter show dev v0p1 ingress
readback.name: verify
